# 8. Finish Activity/Journal/Context/Calendar UI and agent operating guide

## User outcome
The shipped surfaces expose real canonical records and agent entry points: users can browse Activity, Journal, “What matters today,” and Calendar without being trapped in preview/mock claims, while operators have safe examples for conversation/voice workflows.

## Scope
- After children #1–#7 exist, own all remaining UI integration and polish for `/activity`, `/journal`, Session Context, and top-level Calendar. Do not leave “UI ownership until later” ambiguous.
- Remove page-local/static mock sources and connect to real API read/write contracts. Add responsive accessible states, provenance/uncertainty/freshness, correction/readback, approval/proposal flows, and source links.
- Add agent operating examples for initial conversation/voice capture, follow-up, explicit routine reschedule, flare handling, daily check-in, weekly grounding, and safe refusal boundaries. Examples must not imply a recorder, manual form, direct PT integration, LLM API, diagnosis, silent healing, or reminders.
- This final UI slice owns remaining Activity/Journal/Session Context UI only; Calendar implementation remains child #7 and daily context/backend remains child #4. Do not duplicate those implementations.

## Non-goals
New backend contracts, fake fixtures as product behavior, broad personal diary, full sports module, deployment, PR/merge, cron/reminders, production data changes, or external side effects.

## Acceptance
- Browser verification uses safe populated fictional fixtures and covers Activity assigned/actual history, Journal source links/uncertainty, flare/proposal approval, cross-thread check-in readback, session context, top-level Calendar and workout-only view.
- Responsive/accessibility checks cover mobile and desktop, keyboard/focus, loading/empty/error/stale/conflict states, and console/network failures.
- Agent examples are source-bound to real endpoints and explicitly distinguish user, clinician-relay, and agent provenance.
- Return screenshots/readbacks, exact commands/results, changed files, and explicit confirmation no prohibited actions occurred.

## Fixed contract for every slice

This is planning only. Do not deploy, migrate production data, change cron/configuration, open a PR, or make other external changes. Use the repository's existing conventions and return source-bound tests/readbacks. The initial capture entry point is agent-managed conversation/voice, like food logging: do not build a voice recorder, manual-entry forms, direct PT integration, or an LLM API inside Pulse. The agent may correct grammar/typos but must preserve meaning, timing, uncertainty, source, and provenance; unknown is not a negative finding.

The app/backend owns canonical identity, persistence, date/time and timezone semantics, recurrence/revision history, immutable records, authorization, idempotency, conflict handling, and derived reads. The user owns meaning/corrections and approves meaningful plan changes. Clinician-authored material, user-relayed clinician guidance, user observations, and agent suggestions must remain distinct. No diagnosis, inferred healing/recovery/clearance, unsupported pain causality, silent healing, or reminder/cron behavior.

Authoritative proposal: [`docs/planning/activity-journal-body-context.md`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/docs/planning/activity-journal-body-context.md). Relevant current code includes [`apps/api/src/db/schema/activities.ts`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/apps/api/src/db/schema/activities.ts), [`apps/api/src/db/schema/journal.ts`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/apps/api/src/db/schema/journal.ts), [`apps/api/src/routes/agent/context-store.ts`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/apps/api/src/routes/agent/context-store.ts), [`apps/api/src/routes/v1/context.ts`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/apps/api/src/routes/v1/context.ts), [`apps/api/src/db/schema/scheduled-workouts.ts`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/apps/api/src/db/schema/scheduled-workouts.ts), [`apps/web/src/features/activity`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/tree/main/apps/web/src/features/activity), [`apps/web/src/features/journal`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/tree/main/apps/web/src/features/journal), [`apps/web/src/features/workouts/components/session-context.tsx`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/apps/web/src/features/workouts/components/session-context.tsx), and [`apps/web/src/features/workouts/components/workout-calendar.tsx`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/apps/web/src/features/workouts/components/workout-calendar.tsx).

# 3. Implement body concerns, guidance provenance, and safe flare handling

## User outcome
The agent can record a flare immediately, organize supplied clinician guidance, and distinguish current symptoms from maintenance/recovery state without inventing medical conclusions or silently changing the plan.

## Scope
- Implement concern/capability persistence and APIs against child #1: injuries, limitations, restricted motion, recurring tightness, movement confidence, goals, and maintenance history.
- Separate current symptom state from management/recovery state. Preserve maintenance and prior history even when a concern is not relevant today.
- Store source classes distinctly: clinician-authored, user-relayed clinician guidance, user observation, agent suggestion. Link guidance to the concern/capability and carry freshness/staleness.
- Implement targeted follow-up for materially ambiguous safe use; record a flare immediately with only necessary questions.
- Meaningful upcoming activity/workout changes are proposals requiring explicit approval; explicit routine instructions such as “move my walk to tomorrow” execute directly, idempotently, and with reschedule history.

## Non-goals
Diagnosis, inferred healing/recovery/clearance, automatic treatment, silent healing or meaningful plan change, direct PT integration, manual forms, voice recorder, LLM API, reminders/cron, or clinician communication.

## Acceptance
- Tests prove flare persistence precedes follow-up, source/provenance and stale markers survive correction, maintenance does not erase history, and irrelevant concerns remain tracked.
- A proposed meaningful change cannot execute without approval; an explicit routine move executes once under retry and preserves activity identity/history.
- UI/API readback never labels an agent suggestion as prescribed and never asserts causality or clearance.
- Return focused safety, authorization, conflict, and source-bound tests.

# 2. Implement the Activity lifecycle and assigned-day history

## User outcome
A user can tell the agent “I did five minutes of PT this morning,” accept a suggested activity, or reschedule a prescribed item while retaining what was planned, what actually happened, and the full history.

## Scope
- Implement persistence/API/runtime against child #1 contracts for agent-created Activities, goal links, assigned/planned day, recurrence, revisions, rescheduling, actual execution date/time/outcome, retrospective capture, and source/provenance.
- Keep Activities distinct from structured workouts while exposing links for combined planning/review load.
- Preserve assignments when recurring plans are revised; link Tuesday-planned/Thursday-done rather than rewriting either record. Support multiple goals (family/kids, fitness/conditioning, fat loss, PT, mobility, fun) without treating goals as diagnoses.
- Make retry-safe writes and stale revision errors visible; expose agent reads/writes needed for conversation capture, not manual forms.

## Non-goals
Full sports management, direct PT integration, a voice recorder, manual-entry UI, diagnosis/clearance/pain causality, silent plan changes, nutrition/journal/calendar UI, cron, deployment, or replacing structured workout records.

## Acceptance
- Integration tests cover agent capture, five-minute PT, planned Tuesday/actual Thursday, reschedule preserving identity and revision history, recurrence revision, multiple goal links, duplicate retry, and concurrent stale update.
- Readback proves planned and actual records are separately queryable and one activity is not duplicated as a workout.
- Source/time/uncertainty/provenance survive grammar correction and retrospective capture.

# Activity, Journal, Body Context, and Unified Calendar

## Epic outcome
Pulse should turn natural conversation or voice capture into a faithful record, relevant follow-up, grounded daily context, weekly reflection, and a better next plan: **voice capture → record → follow-up → daily facts → weekly reflection → next plan**.

This epic is the approved consolidated planning contract, not authorization to change code, schema, routes, configuration, cron, production data, deploy, or launch. It requires real cross-feature integration; closing all children independently is not sufficient.

## Delivery sequence

- [ ] Child 1 — Canonical contracts and ownership (backend contract foundation): #176 (https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/issues/176)
- [ ] Child 2 — Activity lifecycle and assigned-day history: #177 (https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/issues/177)
- [ ] Child 3 — Body concerns, guidance provenance, and safe flare handling: #178 (https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/issues/178)
- [ ] Child 4 — Canonical cross-thread daily context and check-in concurrency: #179 (https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/issues/179)
- [ ] Child 5 — Health Journal observations and grounded daily/weekly reflection: #180 (https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/issues/180)
- [ ] Child 6 — Planning and actionable Session Context: #181 (https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/issues/181)
- [ ] Child 7 — Unified top-level Calendar and shared agenda read model: #182 (https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/issues/182)
- [ ] Child 8 — Remaining UI integration, agent operating guide, and end-to-end verification: #183 (https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/issues/183)

## Dependency graph
Child 1 is the contract gate. Children 2–5 depend on it. Child 6 depends on 2–5. Child 7 depends on 2–6. Child 8 depends on 1–7. UI exploration may proceed against agreed shapes, but no child may claim feature completion from mock data or placeholder APIs.

## Cross-cutting fixed contract

The initial entry is agent-managed conversation/voice, like food logging: no manual-entry UI, voice recorder, direct PT integration, or LLM API inside Pulse. Preserve meaning, timing, uncertainty, source, and provenance. Unknown is unknown. The agent interprets and proposes; the app/backend owns canonical persistence, identity, dates/timezones, recurrence/revisions, immutable history, authorization, idempotency, conflicts, and derived reads. The user owns meaning/corrections and approves meaningful plan changes.

Activities are outside structured workouts and support assigned/planned/actual history, recurring revisions, multiple goals, and retrospective capture. Planned and actual are linked, not conflated. Body concerns distinguish symptoms from maintenance/recovery state and clinician-authored, user-relayed, user-observed, and agent-generated sources. Flares are recorded immediately; meaningful plan changes require approval, while explicit routine instructions execute directly and idempotently. Journal is bounded to health, nutrition, movement, injuries, and meaningful observations, with immutable source-linked history and grounded weekly reflection. Daily context is canonical across threads, resumable, deduplicated, and concurrency-safe. “What matters today” uses positive focus, cautions, workload context, and freshness without fake reassurance or fabricated single scores. Calendar is a top-level shared calendar/agenda with filters, calories/macros, planned/actual distinctions, preserved timezone/history, and a workout-only view over the same records.

## Non-goals and approval boundary

No broad personal diary, duplicated workout/Activity sources, diagnosis, inferred healing/clearance, unsupported pain causality, full sports management, proactive schedule/reminders, cron, production migration/deployment, or external side effects. Remaining design choices (labels, presentation, density, wording) must not weaken fixed provenance, approval, history, no-diagnosis, or no-duplication rules.

## Grounding

Authoritative proposal: [`docs/planning/activity-journal-body-context.md`](https://github.com/derekbeau/pulse-fitness-app/blob/main/docs/planning/activity-journal-body-context.md). Current grounding includes `/activity` and `/journal` preview/mock surfaces, basic `journal_entries`, existing source-linked feedback/context routes, agent reads for workouts/nutrition/habits/schedules/body-progress analytics, and a workout-specific calendar. Relevant code is linked in each child issue.

## Epic acceptance

- All eight children are implemented against the shared contracts and their dependency links, with no cycles or missing runtime owner.
- A populated-fixture end-to-end pass proves conversation/voice capture through canonical records, follow-up, daily context, Journal/weekly grounding, planning context, and shared Calendar readback.
- The final report includes exact source/test/browser evidence, real readbacks, unresolved gaps, and confirmation that no deployment, cron, production data, or other prohibited side effect occurred.
